instructions: Closed book. For each item: read the stem only and write your solution in stem_only before you read the options. Then choose the answer labels. Use no sources. Set flag to one sentence when you see a second defensible answer or a missing constraint, else null.

items.stem: A company stores signed contracts as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company manages its own keys in a hardware security module in its data center. Company policy says that the encryption keys must never be stored in AWS. Amazon S3 itself must encrypt each object at rest and decrypt it when an authorized user downloads it. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.label: A
options.text: Allow SSE-C in the bucket's default encryption settings, and send the company's key over HTTPS with every upload request and every download request.

options.label: B
options.text: Encrypt each object in the data center before upload, and also allow SSE-C on the bucket and send the company's key with every request.

options.label: C
options.text: Encrypt each object in the data center with the company's key before upload, and decrypt it in the data center after download.

options.label: D
options.text: Use SSE-KMS with a customer managed key in AWS KMS, and let the company's security team control the key policy and the key rotation.

items.stem: A company stores application logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each log file is larger than 1 MB, and the bucket holds the only copy. Engineers read the logs often for 30 days and rarely from day 30 to day 90, when a log must still open in milliseconds. After 90 days, the logs are an archive: auditors read a few logs each year and can wait up to 24 hours for a log. The company must retain the logs for 7 years and then delete them. Which solution is the MOST cost-effective way to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.text: Add one lifecycle rule that transitions the logs to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days, and moves a log back to S3 Standard when an auditor asks for it.

options.label: B
options.text: Add one lifecycle rule that transitions the logs to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days and to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days, and expires them after 7 years.

options.label: C
options.text: Add one lifecycle rule that transitions the logs to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days and to S3 One Zone-IA after 90 days, and expires them after 7 years.

options.label: D
options.text: Add one lifecycle rule that transitions the logs to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 90 days, and expires them after 7 years.
